Scenario 1: Corporate successfully donates to a project resource

steps.title: GIVEN a project with available resources
AND a corporate user is authenticated
WHEN the corporate donates 10 units of "Gloves"
THEN the donation is recorded successfully
AND the resource quantity is reduced by 10
AND the corporate receives a confirmation

specs.title: Scenario 2: Corporate tries to donate more than available

steps.title: GIVEN a resource with only 5 units remaining
WHEN the corporate tries to donate 10 units
THEN the request is rejected with 400
AND an error message explains only 5 units are available

specs.title: Scenario 3: Corporate donates the final units needed

steps.title: GIVEN a resource with 5 units remaining
WHEN the corporate donates exactly 5 units
THEN the resource becomes fully funded
AND the response indicates isFullyFunded = true
AND remaining quantity becomes 0

specs.title: Scenario: NGO views resource status for their project

steps.title: GIVEN an NGO owns a project with multiple resources
AND some resources have received donations
WHEN the NGO requests resource status
THEN they see detailed status for each resource
AND donation history is included for resources with donations
AND quantities are calculated correctly

specs.title: Scenario: NGO creates a new resource for their project

steps.title: GIVEN an authenticated NGO
AND they have an existing project
WHEN they create a new resource "Water Bottles" with quantity 200
THEN the resource is created successfully
AND it appears in the project resource list

specs.title: Scenario: NGO updates an existing resource

steps.title: GIVEN an existing resource "Gloves" with quantity 50
WHEN the NGO updates the quantity to 75
THEN the resource is updated successfully
AND the new quantity is reflected in responses

specs.title: Scenario: NGO deletes a resource

steps.title: GIVEN a resource that is no longer needed
WHEN the NGO deletes it
THEN the resource is removed
AND subsequent GET requests return 404

specs.title: Scenario: Corporate cannot modify resources

steps.title: GIVEN a corporate user
WHEN they try to update a resource
THEN the request is forbidden with 403
AND when they try to delete a resource
THEN that is also forbidden with 403
